reviews.reason: Retain only an uncaptured friendly piece selected while the opponent reply is pending. Movement still waits for the player turn and uses newly computed legal destinations. src/components/LocalGameBoard.tsx: acceptCrown and executeMove retain valid friendly selection; handleSquareClick turn/pending guards and localMoveDestinations recomputation remain unchanged.
